headline: Fuel and filling complex "Manas" renamed State Enterprise "Manas Invest"
summary: The Manas fuel and filling complex has been renamed the state enterprise Manas Invest under a government resolution signed by Prime Minister Adylbek Kasymaliev. The resolution formalises the change.
why: State-owned enterprises in Kyrgyzstan control key fuel and investment assets, and changes to their status can affect fuel supply and state investment policy.
original_headline: Топливно-заправочный комплекс «Манас» переименован в ГП «Манас Инвест»
